title: Clinical Applications of Domperidone in Patients With Delayed Gastric Emptying
brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to treat patients with on-going slow stomach emptying(gastroesophageal reflux disease), who have failed to respond to standard therapy
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Persistent esophagitis
* Heartburn
* Nausea
* Vomiting
* Severe dyspepsia
* Severe chronic constipation

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of, or current arrhythmias including ventricular tachycardia, - Ventricular fibrillation and Torsade des Pointes.
